brief: GS weekly US equities color, week ending Sept 25, 2026: SPX +1.21%, NDX +3.25%, R2K -0.68%, SPX closing 71bps from ATHs. Strait of Hormuz tensions dominated macro sentiment until Friday, when NYT reported Iran proposed a conditional plan to reopen the Strait within seven days and resume nuclear talks, providing late-week relief. The US-China trade truce was extended two months as Xi arrived in Washington for his first state visit in eleven years, supporting risk assets mid-week. Oil's surge plus hot flash September PMIs pushed yields through post-2007 highs; the 30-year hit its highest since 2004 Thursday, partially recovering Friday as oil retreated. Following the PMI data, Oct hike odds rose to 66% from 53% the prior Friday. Post-FOMC, Fed officials Barr, Schmid and Barkin struck a hawkish tone on inflation. Meta's Muse release drove AI-agentic proliferation, hitting the Consumer Inertia Basket -4.54% on the week while META rose ~11% Monday as Muse topped app-store charts, reviving the momentum trade (High Beta Momentum basket +6.61%, 9-day win streak). Asset managers and hedge funds were both net sellers on the week. Next week: implied S&P move 1.27% through Oct 2, with OpenAI Dev Day, PCE, ISM, NFP and MU earnings ahead.
